(1) a significant proportion of drivers in Arizona carry guns in their cars; (2) drivers who carry a gun in their car are more likely to engage in aggressive and hostile behavior behind the wheel than are drivers who do not carry a gun in the vehicle; and (3) drivers who carry guns are more likely to brandish their guns in a threatening manner toward other drivers.

11% of Arizona drivers report having carried a firearm in the car in the 12-month period prior to the survey and that drivers who carry a gun in their vehicle are much more likely to report engaging in aggressive and illegal behavior on the road.

11% of Arizona drivers reported carrying a gun while driving; 34% of drivers reported making obscene gestures, cursing, and/or shouting angrily at other drivers; and 28% of drivers reported aggressively following or blocking the paths of other drivers.
